Loans: POST /loans (lend a book; body contains bookId and memberId; 404 if either not found; 409 if book is already on loan; a member may hold at most 3 active loans — 422 if exceeded), POST /loans/{id}/return (mark returned; 404 if loan absent; 409 if already returned), GET /loans?memberId={id} (list all loans for a member, active and returned)
The 422 response is produced without the loan being persisted (subsequent GET /loans?memberId={id} does not include the rejected loan)
The returned state is persisted in the shared LoanRepository and reflected in subsequent GET /loans?memberId={id} results
